text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. Developers often refactor to make their code easier to read and understand. This is important because clean code is simpler to maintain and update. Refactoring also helps reduce technical debt, which builds up when quick fixes are used instead of proper solutions. By regularly improving code structure, teams can avoid bigger problems in the future. However, it is essential to remember that refactoring should never change the behaviour of the software. The program must still work exactly as before, just with better, cleaner code underneath.
